notes.title: Ascending Inferno v1.5 and Japan Launch
notes.notes:
[p][b][u]Japanese Localisation: [/u][/b][/p][p]Ascending Inferno is now fully playable in Japanese! Special thanks to PINION and Rié Ihara for localising the game and bringing Ascending Inferno to the Japanese market! To our Japanese Players: We hope you enjoy the game, and maybe one of you will be able to finally dethrone Stepogear for the fastest speed-runner![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332320/1f4cdbf7a171c853688110388ac3f04e22fd4e15.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332320/42d1dbdc033382641f7eada8252dbdfdbf1c83ec.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Level Redesigns:[/u][/b][/p][p]Every level in Ascending Inferno has received some sort of tweak or redesign. As these changes range in size, here’s a few ones we wanted to highlight:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Extended Tutorial[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332320/43644a8753ae8d3265a787093893377580dcb8e4.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Limbo Throne Room[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332320/976db41deb324cdacbefcf254b10a4a0f01ecbf8.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Bottom of Greed[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332320/be20d5b824bbb4801969973c8fd09adf84983ba3.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Right Path of Heresy[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332320/cae24546f5c407a52bf61b0a70d8d7968625a7f8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]And many more changes![/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Optimisation:[/u][/b][/p][p]Oh, lordy he optimising…[/p][p]There have been so many optimisation changes, we honestly lost count. But the end result is simple: A smoother and more frame filled experience for you as you ascend through Inferno.  [/p][p] [/p][p][u][b]UI Overhaul[/b][/u][/p][p]All of the UI in Ascending Inferno has been overhauled and redesigned from the ground up. It not only has a ton of visual flair now, but should also be more intuitive and function better for both keyboard and controller. Here’s a few screenshots:[/p][p]New Skin Menu:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332320/bbb7a73f888a8934f3e4afe38482dd04d3e78012.jpg"][/img][/p][p]New Setting Screen:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332320/c3fbf7e6f29609fec7316d61488fb9863c4c838d.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][b][u]OST Bonus Tracks:[/u][/b][/p][p]Dan Poole you mad man…[/p][p]Our amazing composer Dan added 15 new tracks to our OST available on steam. This brings the total song count to 26!!! The added tracks are for all the cut-scene music and features both the With SFX and Music Only versions.   If you want to support Dan Poole directly, all sales of Ascending Inferno’s OST on steam goes directly to him. It’s now currently on sale to celebrate the launch of our 1.5 update and is available here: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3312870/Ascending_Inferno_Soundtrack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][b][u]QOL (The Juice):[/u][/b][/p][p]Who spilled all this Gyatt damn juice?!?[/p][p]The game has been juiced up in so many places! This should make your playthrough of Ascending Inferno feel more satisfying (from a game feel perspective). The juices changes include but are not limited to:[/p][list][*][p]New SFX for moving Vincent around.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]New animations for when you interact with checkpoints.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Checkpoints have also had a VFX overhaul to be clearer for when they are and aren’t activated.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’re honestly super pumped about this point as holistically it all just made inferno nicer and a bit more tolerable to climb 😊[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Multiple Bug Fixes:[/u][/b][/p][p]Just like our optimization changes, we did so many bug fixes that we genuinely lost count. Some of the big main ones are:[/p][list][*][p]All achievements are now earnable (oops).[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]All the training grounds are now completable.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Dani no longer teleports herself out of the limbo secret room if on checkpoint mode (that’s not how you’re meant to escape).[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]And way way more (bro you gotta believe me).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][u][b]Ultrawide support?[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]The game now supports ultrawide monitors! (Maybe?). Honestly we’re a bit psychotic and decided it would be a good idea to add this to the patch 1 hour before it went live (we are still working on it right now as I type these patch notes). So please let us know if it’s Jank and we’ll hotfix it![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][u][b]Monthly Game Modes?[/b][/u][/p][p]A new option exists on the main menu called “Challenges”, it is here that you’ll be able to access our new Monthly Challenges![/p][p]This however is currently inaccessible as we still wanted to polish up our first one. We promise it’ll be out soon, and we’ll do an announcement for it so keep your eyes peeled! [/p][p] [/p][p]I will give you a teaser as a reward for reading this far… The first monthly challenge is called “Hot Potato”. 

[/p][p][u][b]Thank you![/b][/u][/p][p]Honestly and sincerely, thank you all for playing our silly little ball rage game. It honestly means the world to us here. Seeing your reviews on our steam page is so heart-warming and makes all the late nights of deving worth it.[/p][p]We hope you enjoy this new update, and stick around to see what else we are cooking! 😊[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332320/aea82bb362f400900fb1150a781b998382d421da.jpg"][/img][/p][p] (ignore how dead we look here, we are used to it :) )[/p][p][b] [/b][/p]

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Checkpoint Update
notes.notes:
[h1] Checkpoint Gamemode[/h1]
When beginning a new game you may now choose between playing with or without Checkpoints!
Checkpoints have been scattered throughout Inferno to help reduce some of the suffering that comes from larger falls. If you would like a less stressful experience of hell, this game mode is for you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332320/d330cb37aaf7af6d4149f5c9468e9456459ec51c.png[/img]

Just keep an eye out for one these gravestones and you will be able to respawn here after a large fall![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332320/1a651cf426866cdde7bcbc820f3f9b8ccbf6185e.png[/img]

[h1]Wrath Update[/h1]
Wrath has recieved a small bit of love, with a new sliding effect for the shutes at the top of the level. To successfully beat this section will require fast reflexes and careful coordination as you juggle Vincent over the large gaps of the shute.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332320/c7fcfbc5801f9bc86a38a4d30f84bab548ac7412.png[/img]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with the training grounds that caused the game to crash when opening the menu.
[*]Fixed an issue with the Wrath training grounds that caused some platforms to have no hitboxes (the level should be completable now)
[*]Fixed an issue with the Heresy training grounds causing it to be unbeatable.
[*]Fixed an issue with the tutorial training grounds causing it to reward you with a rating of D instead of B+
[*]Cleaned Up some collisions in Treachery, Fraud, Wrath & Greed
[*]Added some train SFX in Heresy
[*]Cleaned up some Menu UI!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332320/fb860e5f2608dd9ec162e1451a7eb5d8ee9a6fd4.png[/img]

[h1]Get a copy of the Ascending Inferno OST[/h1]
Our OST composed by Dan Poole and featuring Amelia Jones is now available to be purchased!

This album features the main theme, and the tracks for each level throughout the game (including the tutorial).
All Proceeds go directly to Dan Pool, our talented composer!
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50903/Ascending_Inferno__Original_Soundtrack/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3312870/Ascending_Inferno_Soundtrack/

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
This update unlocks the training ground game mode! available from the Main Menu!
It also addresses several bugs that have been pointed out since launch!

[h2]Training Ground Game Mode[/h2]
Once you have successfully beaten a level in the game mode, you will unlock it in the training grounds!
The training grounds provide a way for you to practice any of the levels you have beaten once before, so that you can find shortcuts, limit test, and beat your times!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332320/5077a7aaf87e111cbdbfc9921baa8354caf804e8.png[/img]
Your best time for each training ground is automatically saved, and after each run you are granted a score from D to S+ (earning an S or higher will grant you an achievement for the level!) 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332320/cb315b8617a34a2595051770e837c22455c4ac4d.png[/img]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the customisation menu not allowing you to select a customisation for Vincent.
[*] Fixed an issue with the customisation menu with Vincent's wings & hat not appearing.
[*] Fixed an issue with the customisation menu with being able to hit the left and right button infinitely.
[*] Fixed some collision issues, including being able to stand on the lust door frame.
[*] Fixed an issue with the falling achievement, it now tracks your total meters fallen during gameplay.
[*] Fixed an issue with Vincent being off-screen with the height tracker, in the bottom of limbo.
[*] Fixed an issue with AO rendering through transparency
[*] Fixed the hard lock in the Wrath Secret Room, where Vincent could get stuck on the roof.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Wrath music being cut off halfway through.
[*] Fixed some collision issues in Violence, allowing Vincent to get stuck in small Gaps.
[*] Fixed an Audio Overlapping issue
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332320/6e1f14678ba20e890622a6ef6ff43f61223026c1.png[/img]
[h2]Quality of Life Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Lust is now slightly easier! (The dancers in the rave room in particular are less punishing)
[*] Added dead zone to the controller joystick.
[*] Added the ability to customise the Jump on the D-pad for controller
[/list]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo!
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, Traveler![/b]

Welcome to our exclusive Next Fest demo and patch notes! We've packed this build with exciting new content that we hope you'll enjoy. Here's a quick summary of the updates:
•	Lust and parts of Gluttony are now playable
•	Speedrunning competition
•	New Prologue and Death Cutscene
•	Slight character movement changes
•	Quality of life improvements
•	And so much more!!!

Now, let's dive into the details!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332320/39e76377747295198f1db72e84158f98c7ed5909.jpg[/img]

[b]Club Lust:[/b]

The most significant update is that Lust is now fully playable for Next Fest! Test your skills as you ascend this layer of hell, but be careful with your movements. Lust’s unique mechanic involves the Dancers. If Vincent strays too close, he'll fall under a “siren-like” effect, being pulled closer before being launched in a direction (usually outside of the club). Keep an eye out for multiple dancers throughout the club!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Pdx44Bj.png[/img]


[b]Gluttony: [/b]

The demo now ends in Gluttony, allowing players to experience the first third of the level! The unique mechanic for this layer is "hotplates." When Vincent steps on a hotplate, he'll start burning from the heat, causing him to bounce uncontrollably until he’s off the platform. The longer he stays on a hotplate, the more intense the bounces become!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2fDsdwF.png[/img]
  

[b]Speedrunning competition: [/b]

Exclusively for Steam Next Fest, we're hosting a Speedrunning competition! We've previously posted the rules, but to participate, join our community Discord linked below.

[url=https://discord.gg/5fsjXJTxFC][img]https://i.imgur.com/G6andPn.png[/img][/url]

[b]New Prologue and Death Cutscene:[/b]

We've added brand new cutscenes to enhance the story. The prologue cutscene plays when you start a new game, and the death cutscene appears after the tutorial section. For those who prefer to skip the story, you can bypass cutscenes and dialogue by hitting the pause button. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332320/7f03dcf67b654948716a9354303f34cd669deb60.png[/img]


[b]Slight character movements changes:[/b]

Welcome to all new players! For our longtime supporters, you’ll notice that Dani now has a slight delay when falling from a certain height, pausing for half a second. This makes it harder to chase Vincent during a big fall and slightly slows the game pace.

[b]Quality of life changes and more:[/b]

We've made numerous improvements across the demo. These include, but are not limited to:
•	Bug fixes
•	Enhanced visual art and flair
•	New music
•	New sound effects (SFX)
•	Updated secret room dialogues
•	Expanded graphics settings (that actually work this time, we promise!)
•	Performance and optimization enhancements
•	Improved visual effects (VFX)
•	Better visual clarity in certain areas
•	And much more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332320/9443038bd9cc43988e952792c97fe3f0b3443890.png[/img]


[b]A thanks from the dev team:[/b]

We want to extend our heartfelt thanks to everyone, both new and returning players, for trying out our demo and supporting us. We are tirelessly working to make Ascending Inferno the best it can be, and your feedback is invaluable. We hope you enjoy what has been two years in the making, and we can’t wait to share even more with you soon!

notes.title: Speedrunning Contest: Next Fest Edition!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332320/9443038bd9cc43988e952792c97fe3f0b3443890.png[/img]

To celebrate the launch of our Next Fest Demo we have decided to run a special one of a kind Speedrunning Competition! 

The Fastest 5 players to beat our new demo will have the chance to be immortalized in the game forever. A secret room/shrine will be built with the winners' names or in-game names commemorated for all to see and stumble upon when the game fully releases!

To throw your hat into the ring, just drop a YouTube video or stream VOD link (timestamped please!) of your run into the contest-submissions channel of our [url=https://discord.gg/2y2ZjyySfE ]discord[/url]: [url=https://discord.gg/2y2ZjyySfE ]https://discord.gg/2y2ZjyySfE [/url]

Feel free to go for multiple attempts! If you nail a sweet time early on but spot a new trick or faster times popping up as the contest rolls on, take another shot at it!

The contest kicks off and wraps up right alongside the June 2024 Steam Next Fest (June 11, 2024 3:00AM AEST to June 18, 2024 3:00AM). Once Next Fest Ends, we'll lock down the contest submissions.

The final time for your run will be the time that is displayed on the End Demo Screen!

The build / demo of the game that is being judged for this contest is the Steam Next Fest Demo. This includes the Tutorial, Limbo, Lust and the start of Gluttony.

Whilst we're keeping it fair and square for the main prizes (no game-breaking bugs, cheats or exploits allowed), we've got a separate prize for the most hilariously mind-boggling run pulled off thanks to a glitch or exploit!

Best of luck to everyone! We can't wait to see the crazy skill and dedication that come out of your runs! Ascending Inferno is built with the speedrunning community in mind, so we're super keen to hear your thoughts and feedback to make the full game even better!

Don't forget to join the [url=https://discord.gg/2y2ZjyySfE ]discord [/url]to submit your best time! 
[url=https://discord.gg/2y2ZjyySfE ]https://discord.gg/2y2ZjyySfE [/url]

notes.title: Alpha Patch 1.5
notes.notes:
Summary:
·         New music!
·         Dialogue system and narrative secret rooms!
·         Ball cam!
·         Tons of optimisation and performance improvement!
·         Tutorial visual revamp!
·         Training grounds are now unlocked!
·         And so much more 👀👀👀👀
 
Details: 
New Music Tracks in Limbo and Lust. 
These tracks aren’t finished but should convey the vibe we’re going for. 
 
New Dialogue System.
New system in place for our main narrative beats. For players who want to dive deeper into the narrative and the character dynamics between Dani and Vincent, we have hidden the narrative behind secret rooms and areas. Be on the lookout for these secret rooms. 
 
Ball Cam.
You now get front row seats to your mistakes! Now, whenever Vincent is off screen, a camera will appear in the top right to show where he is.
 
NOTE: This is a high performance cost feature, as it’s essentially rendering the game twice to function. Ball Cam is currently switched off by default, but you can enable it in the settings if you would like to try/ you have a powerful PC.
 
Tutorial Visual Revamp.
Our tutorial section has been somewhat of the unloved child of the game. It’s now had a visual revamp that brings it in line with our other levels and as a result is much prettier! (We love it now we swear!!)
 
Tons of Optimization
There are way too many to count! Across the board you should see higher performance and FPS. As well as our graphics settings have had an overhaul with a lot more love given to lower end systems whilst still passing the Oppolyon vibe check. (Even on low settings the game looks real nice)
 
 The Training Grounds
The training grounds are a way of practising levels that you have already completed in the main game, access them from the main menu and good luck trying to beat your PBs!

notes.title: Alpha 1.0
notes.notes:
Ascending Inferno Alpha 1.0 Patch Notes:

Here is a big update featuring:
•	Extended Tutorial map with new challenges to face!
•	Extended Limbo map with a whole new dungeon area.
•	A new Ghost Tutorial system which is hopefully less intrusive to experienced players, whilst also more beneficial to new players!
•	A whole new UI menu which is (hopefully) fully controller compatible!


Here are all the details:
Level Design:

Tutorial:
Tutorial has received a major redesign! We have created a new underground section to give players more opportunity to practice the basic ball movement before moving onto harder challenges! 
We have also removed the cut-scene that plays at the beginning of the game so that players can get into the action right away!
The (old) first section of the tutorial has now been balanced to be more difficult, focusing on the headbutt mechanics to balance out the introduction of the new section.

Limbo:
The Limbo dungeon has been one of our choke-points for newer players for a little while and so we’ve finally gotten around to changing it around!
It is now much deeper than before and has multiple paths for the player to explore and find the fastest route out.
We hope it is a bit more fun to be stuck down in the dungeon now than it was before! 

Other Features:
New Tutorial Ghost: no more waiting for GIFS to explain the game. Instead, follow the long-lost memory of Vincent as he makes his way through the tutorial!
Level Banners: We’ve introduced a couple of level banners to pop-up and celebrate when you make it to a new level of hell!
Overhauled UI: We have overhauled the UI! It should now be fully controller compatible & also comes along with a few new game-play options that you can enable or disable:
-	Height Progress Bar
-	Timer
-	Tutorial Tips (The ghosts)
-	Character Dialogue
-	Controller Vibrate
We are also currently looking at introducing accessibility options but need your help to do so! If you have ideas, please reach out and let us know!

We also have new music in the main menu, you may recognise it from the trailer! We hope you like it!

Bug Fixes:
I don’t really remember them all, but we fixed being able to kick Vincent into a wall continuously (poor guy) and that was kind of the highlight.
